faq.question: How secure is my financial data?
faq.answer: We utilize Layer-1 AES-256 encryption with a zero-knowledge architecture. This means even our systems cannot decrypt your raw transaction data; only your private key holds the access.

faq.question: Can I connect multiple international banks?
faq.answer: Yes. Finotive supports 5,000+ global financial institutions across 40 countries, providing a unified neural dashboard for your entire net worth.

faq.question: How does the AI predict my future expenses?
faq.answer: Our neural engine uses recurrent models to identify seasonal patterns, subscription decays, and discretionary spending vectors with 99.9% historical accuracy.

faq.question: Is there a mobile application available?
